images.scroll_few_lines: An old open parchment scroll on a wooden reading stand with only a few short golden glowing lines, soft candle light, the rest of the scroll empty and calm, no readable letters.
images.quiet_garden_dawn: A quiet walled garden at dawn with a stone path, a small fountain and blossoming trees, peaceful and humble atmosphere.
images.hourglass_sand: A wooden hourglass on a windowsill with golden sand slowly falling, soft morning light, patience and calm.
images.seed_waiting_rain: A small seed in dark soil with a few raindrops falling around it under a grey sky, a tiny green sprout just starting, patience and hope.
images.hidden_kindness: A small basket of bread and fruit placed quietly at the door of a simple house at dawn, nobody present, a gentle golden light, secret kindness.
images.unknown_flowers_field: A wide meadow full of small humble wildflowers in soft evening light, one flower gently glowing among them, nobody present.
images.mercy_light_clouds: Soft golden light streaming through gentle clouds over green hills at sunset, peaceful, merciful and warm.
